name: OKAFOR VICTOR SOMTO

headline: I partner with founders and teams to design and build polished web products, practical AI features, and reliable APIs—from the first prototype through launch.

about.title: A thoughtful engineering partner for your next big idea.
paragraphs: I’m OKAFOR VICTOR SOMTO, a full-stack developer, AI engineer, and creative technologist based in Nigeria. I help turn ambitious ideas into considered digital products—with clear communication and engineering that respects the people who will use them.

From responsive web experiences and robust APIs to practical AI prototypes, I work across the details that make a product feel coherent: useful features, thoughtful interfaces, reliable foundations, and a path from early concept to launch.

contact.intro: Have a product idea, a workflow worth improving, or a complex build to untangle? Share the goal, what you’ve tried, and your ideal timeline. I’ll respond with a straightforward next step—no jargon, just a practical conversation.
